Heard on I.A. No.24892/2025 , third application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C./Section 430(1) of BNSS, for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the appellant.

His first application was dismissed on merits vide order dated 13.09.2019 and second application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 04.07.2025.
2.

This appeal has been preferred against the judgment dated 26.11.2018 passed by Special Judge,
POCSO Act, District Betul (M.P.) in S.T. No.144/2014, whereby the appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:
Conviction U/s. Imprisonment Fine In lieu of fine 376(2)(jha) of IPC Life imprisonment Rs.5000/-
Additional R.I. for three months 3.

entities.text:
Special Judge,
POCSO Act, District Betul (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the trial Court has wrongly convicted and sentenced the appellant.
As per prosecution case, the allegation against the appellant is that he committed rape upon the minor prosecutrix aged about 10 years.

Learned counsel submits that the appellant is the biological father of the prosecutrix and due to some animosity with the mother-in-law of the appellant, he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The trial Court has not appreciated the evidence properly.
The prosecution has failed to prove the case beyond reasonable doubt.
There are material contradictions and omissions in the testimonies of the prosecution witnesses.
Learned counsel further submits that in the present case no DNA test was conducted and there is no DNA report on record.

The appellant has already undergone almost 10 years of incarceration, therefore,
the application may be considered on the ground of period of incarceration.
This appeal is of the year 2019 and there is no possibility of early hearing of the appeal in near future.
He is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by the directions and conditions, which may be imposed by this Court.
Hence, it is prayed that the application for suspension of sentence may be allowed.

4 . Learned counsel for the State on the other hand has opposed the application for suspension of Panjab Rav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76596882/
1 sentence and supported the impugned judgment of conviction and sentence passed by the trial Court.

sentences.text: 5. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

6 . Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, the overall facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that there is no DNA report on record as well as period of incarceration already undergone by the appellant, we are of the opinion that the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant can be considered.
7. Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, I.A. No.24892/2025 is allowed.

8 . It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, the remaining jail sentence of the appellant is hereby suspended 3 CRA-3698-2019 and he be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 17.02.2026 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during pendency of this appeal.
9. List the matter for final hearing in due course.

(VIVEK KUMAR SINGH) (HIMANS  JUDGE JU  Shanu Panjab Rav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76596882/
